text: Rewee Alla Tun, hara on kafidaali e Makko goɗɗum goo. Moƴƴon e jibimɓe on ɓen ; teddinon ɓe ɗoftoɗon ɓe, moƴƴoɗon e joomiraaɓe ɓadondiral ɓen, e alyatimeeɓe ɓen, e waasuɓe ɓen, moƴƴoɗon e kawtalo jom-ɓadondiral, e kawtaljo woɗɗitiiɗo ka enɗam, moƴƴoɗon e wonndiiɗo on ka yahdu, moƴƴoɗon e seteejo tumaraŋkeejo, moƴƴoɗon e ɓen ɓe jeyruɗon ñaame mon. Pellet, Alla Yiɗaa on laatiiɗo ñaaƴoowo towniŋtiniiɗo e yimɓe ɓen, mantoowo hoore-mun hakkunde yimɓe.
